REVIEWER's actual ruling (step-02d-reviewer.json), read directly, not from CODE-DESIGNER's characterization: M6's insert-if-absent creation of an instance_projections row on an instance's first append oversteps EE-01/S3's deferred 'meaningful population at instance-start' territory -- FAIL, blocking, with an explicit recommendation: 'M1 returns a distinct error (such as {:error, :instance_not_started}) instead of :new_instance when no row exists, and M6 becomes update-only, using InstanceProjection.update_changeset/2.'

Verified each of the four claimed changes against the actual diff (git show 6345250 -- lib/letflow/design/req025-event-append.md) and the current file text, not the handoff's self-report:
(1) Section 5.3 -- {:error, :instance_not_started} added as a new variant (lines 302-308), explicitly annotated as distinct from {:error, {:instance_terminated, status}} (lines 309-312, 'Only reachable when an instance_projections row DOES exist ... a missing row is always :instance_not_started above instead'). Confirmed present.
(2) Section 6.2.1 (M1) -- the 'no row found' branch (lines 488-497) now reads 'fail the step with {:error, :instance_not_started}', with the old ':new_instance' success branch and its 'M6 must therefore be able to CREATE this row' rationale fully removed (confirmed via diff -- the whole old paragraph is a deletion, not a partial edit). Confirmed present.
(3) Section 6.2.6 (M6, lines 672-695) -- rewritten to 'This step is update-only -- it never creates an instance_projections row', uses InstanceProjection.update_changeset/2 exclusively, and explicitly states 'never insert_changeset/2 and never an on_conflict:-based upsert' and 'This is a plain UPDATE keyed on instance_id, not an upsert -- there is no \"row absent\" branch here'. Confirmed present; the old upsert pseudocode block is fully replaced, not left alongside.
(4) Section 9 OQ-5 (lines 833-853) -- now headed 'OQ-5 -- RESOLVED per REVIEWER's Step 2d ruling (...), no longer open', restates REVIEWER's four-point reasoning (AC-text asymmetry, 'at instance start' framing, update_changeset/2 as the intended tool, the counter-argument being non-decisive), and states the resolution matches M1/M6 above. Internal self-consistency check (the specific risk this re-validation was asked to rule out): grepped the whole file for 'new_instance' -- zero hits anywhere (the prior success-case atom is completely gone, not just renamed in one spot). M6 only ever updates an existing row, never creates one') from InstanceSequence/IdempotencyRecord ('upsert-via-insert_changeset/2 + on_conflict:') in the same sentence -- correctly stated, not contradictory. No surviving reference anywhere in the file to M6 creating/inserting a row or to :new_instance as a success case.
